rounding: nearest normalized value in the unbounded-exponent lattice; halfway ties away from zero
range_policy: after rounding, reject nonzero results outside configured exponent bounds; do not saturate, flush or substitute zero
fma: exact product plus exact addend, one final rounding; product range is not checked prematurely
sqrt: nearest to exact positive real square root using squared midpoint comparisons
binary64_import: exact finite IEEE binary64 input value, one ternary rounding; both binary zeros become canonical zero; reject NaN and infinities
binary64_export: nearest IEEE binary64 ties-to-even; may produce infinity or signed underflow zero; independent of host rounding mode
sdk_record: native ABI value struct, NOT an on-disk or hardware wire format; reserved fields zero; canonical inputs only
not_qualified: arbitrary widths or alternative rounding modes
